semiconductor_relevance: None — Dixon Technologies is primarily an Electronics Manufacturing Services provider with no specific focus on semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: Dixon Technologies is a leading Electronics Manufacturing Services provider in India, offering end-to-end design and manufacturing solutions for consumer electronics and home appliances. The company is expanding into laptop and PC manufacturing and has a joint venture for OEM lighting products.
capabilities: End-to-end design and manufacturing solutions for consumer electronics
Laptop and PC manufacturing under the PLI scheme

regional_presence.India: Dixon Technologies is investing ₹1,000 crore to establish a laptop and PC manufacturing facility in Oragadam, Tamil Nadu.
